summary: Dark and light alternating page: a huge-title head, a two-model comparison (TaaS vs MaaS), a dark AI and security block, a tool tile mosaic, a five-step tabbed process, a solution tile grid beside an FAQ and a closing call-to-action. Needs two engagement models, an AI tool list of six, five security features and five setup steps.

sections.note: peach ground; enormous serif title centered with a one-line lead, directly followed by the comparison card (head and card share the first screen)

one big cream card split in two halves with a thin divider: each has a serif model name, a one-line description, a label How it is different, four ticks, and a full-height flat illustration of a person at the outer edge

charcoal band after a wavy edge: huge white heading, lead, sub-heading, six items in two columns each with a round icon, a bold name and one line; then a security sub-heading with five items in two columns
heading and a tile mosaic: grey rounded tiles with a capability name mixed with four coloured portrait tiles
peach band: heading Get set up in five easy steps; two folder tabs (TaaS, MaaS); five numbered white pills in a grid of three plus two; a pill button below
heading left; ten flat illustration tiles in a grid of three with a name and arrow; FAQ column right (three accordion rows and a dark pill link)
heading, paragraph and a coral pill button left, three-person illustration right
